selection: Gentle instrumental anime and Ghibli arrangements: timestamped relaxing PianoDeuss collections, Torby Brand piano/strings covers, kno piano first cycles, and anime-related tracks from Celestial Aeon Project's instrumental sleep collections.
excluded: Vocal/guest vocal, English/band/accompaniment covers, explicitly epic/battle/hard arrangements, unrelated tracks, repeated URLs, repeated performer/title identities, and looped tails.
cutoff_note: The nighttime mix repeats from 1:03:40. The daytime mix's last chapter includes its repeated tail, so that chapter is excluded rather than guessing its endpoint.
duplicates: URL/start/end identities and normalized performer/title identities are deduplicated within this genre. Existing classical genres remain unchanged. Different performers' interpretations of a composition may occur; recordings have not been audio-fingerprinted.
